USER: create the most realistic and accurate 3D model of the taj majal (with surrounding scenery). build a camera system to allow free view inspection of the model.

Put it all together in the end with a 20 second showcase in a very impressive way. You will be the director of that 20 second showcase, make the most of it, make it cinematic, and most of all make no mistakes.
ASSISTANT (message): I'll build this as a self-contained Three.js app: a procedurally modeled Taj Mahal (plinth, pishtaq facades, onion dome, chhatris, minarets, mosque & jawab, great gate, charbagh gardens with reflecting pool), a dual-mode camera system (orbit + fly), and a scripted 20-second cinematic showcase. Let me check the workspace first.
